name: ai-resume-analyzer-parent
description: Parent orchestrator for AI Resume Analyzer service

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd AI-Resume-Analyzer/frontend && venv\Scripts\python -m streamlit run app.py --server.headless true
scripts.install:all: npx concurrently "npm run install:backend" "npm run install:frontend"
scripts.install:backend: cd AI-Resume-Analyzer/backend && (if not exist venv python -m venv venv) && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:frontend: cd AI-Resume-Analyzer/frontend && (if not exist venv python -m venv venv) && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
